extraction.notes: Three-months-ended September 30, 2022 column only. FFO total is the diluted figure (199,383), so the Series E preferred distribution (1,106), which sits between basic FFO (198,277) and diluted FFO, is included in ffo_adjustments as 'other'. Zero-valued lines (printed as '-') are included with amount 0. Per-share checks: 199,383/350,078=0.57; 210,259/350,078=0.60; 189,876/350,078=0.54. Recurring capex is in the AFFO section, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null.
